split_protocol: disjoint entire recordings; same sources/roles/windows as improved prediction evaluation

student.teacher: 4-second 4-move exhaustive MPC, closed-loop A; 11 randomized physical cases

dagger.selection: validation only: range acceptance vs A and previous student, then p95+max error; final test after selection

range_acceptance.reference: A baseline; previous deployed checkpoint unavailable

evaluation_protocol.model_selection: validation only; final test is not used to select a round
evaluation_protocol.forward_forecast: hold currently observed forward state, not future recorded flags
evaluation_protocol.sensor_forecast: only own predicted states update future sensor history; no future measured states
evaluation_protocol.acceptance: fixed steady-hold starting abs(error)<=2 and abs(speed)<=0.3, at least 20 windows; compare previous deployed model only if its exact checkpoint is available; otherwise rank validation peak and p95 directly
evaluation_protocol.teacher_candidates: 81 coarse 4-move plans plus 9 local refinements; first move bounded by +/-0.8 cm/s^2

range_acceptance.reference: A baseline; previous deployed checkpoint unavailable

deployment_gate.reason: Offline candidate only; no upload or real-water acceptance

limitations: 4s model MPC uses dynamics validated on 3s predictions
future simulated speed/acceleration are model states, not a full Kalman sensor emulator
commanded/estimated actuators, not physical pump/valve feedback
initial pump phase and direction lock are assumed; 50ms simulation vs 5ms actual motion ticks
existing retrospective validation/test logs have been inspected before; not a prospective trial
